meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 上,Claude 会把技能目录里的 Swift 源码编译成二进制,生成 launchd plist 并加载,菜单栏出现一个闪电图标:绿点表示 NanoClaw 在运行、红点表示已停止,可 Start、Stop、Restart。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 上要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示图标时触发。非 macOS 会停止并说明该技能仅限 macOS;缺少 swiftc(Xcode 命令行工具)会提示先安装。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 装一个 macOS 菜单栏状态图标。
say.note: 先检查平台和 swiftc,再编译安装。

say.text: 看看 NanoClaw 菜单栏图标装好了没。
say.note: 用 launchctl 查服务是否已加载。

say.text: 按 REMOVE.md 把菜单栏状态图标卸载掉。

howto.what_en: On macOS, Claude compiles the skill's Swift source into a binary, writes and loads a launchd plist, so a bolt menu bar icon appears with a green/red dot for NanoClaw's status and Start, Stop, Restart controls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a NanoClaw menu bar status indicator on macOS. On other platforms it stops and says the skill is macOS only; without swiftc (Xcode Command Line Tools) it asks you to install them.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Checks platform and swiftc, then compiles and installs.

say_en.text: Check whether the NanoClaw menu bar icon is installed.
say_en.note: Uses launchctl to see if the service is loaded.

say_en.text: Uninstall the menu bar status icon per REMOVE.md.
